newsitem.title: UK: Tesco to invest 100 mln stg in Irish buy.
newsitem.headline: Tesco to invest 100 mln stg in Irish buy.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc said on Friday it expected to invest more than 100 million stg over the next three years in its purchase of Irish stores including Quinnsworth supermarkets.
Tesco said there would be no earnings dilution from the 630 million stg acquisition and said it was debt free and cash generative.
Tesco said in information provided to journalists arriving for a news conference that the investment would be in areas such as store refurbishment.
The acquisition comprises the Irish food retailing and associated business of Associated British Foods Plc excluding its textile and clothing store businesses Penney's and Primark.
Shares in Tesco were up four pence to 343 following news of the acquisition, while ABF shares were up 11p at 522-1/2.
